Hi Marissa / David,

Thanks again for the demo today — the team at Acme found the latency and cost breakdown especially helpful. Wanted to capture high-level next steps so we can get the POC scheduled: 

- Success criteria: 1) end-to-end inference latency under 300ms p50 for our 512-token prompts; 2) throughput to sustain 50 req/s during peak batch runs; 3) model outputs meet our accuracy benchmarks (>=92% on the internal eval set).
- Evaluation plan: we'll run a two-week trial against a curated eval set (provided by us) plus a live slice of traffic in staging.
- Timeline: hoping to kick off the week of Mar 22 — are you able to run a kickoff then?
- Owners: I can own coordinating the eval data and procurement contact; Marissa / your team to own environment/credentials and weekly syncs.

Can you confirm the proposed success criteria and whether Mar 22 kickoff is feasible? If so, please share a draft timeline and any access/credentials you'll need.

Thanks,

Summary / proposed plan:

- POC duration: 2 full weeks of evaluation (14 days) following kickoff.
- Kickoff options: week of Mar 22 (Mon 3/22) or week of Mar 29 (Mon 3/29) — we prefer 3/22 to hit your desired timeline.
- Weekly cadence: 30-min technical syncs (Tuesdays) + 1 weekly progress email.

1) Eval dataset (shared Drive link or s3) + a short doc describing labeling/metrics.
2) Test/staging endpoint for live traffic slice (if you want live-run evaluation).
3) Procurement/PO contact if we need a short-term trial agreement.
